chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Husayn ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The seeking of forgiveness and the saying "There is no god except Allah" is the best of worship.'
Allah, the Mighty, the Compeller, says: 'So know that there is no god but Allah, and ask forgiveness for your sin.'

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god except Allah (declaration of monotheism)

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of worship according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi, establishes istighfar and tawhid as the pinnacle of worship by linking them to the divine command in Surah Muhammad. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Prophet’s perfect status while still engaging in repentance, illustrating that even the most elevated spiritual figures prioritize humility and acknowledgment of God’s oneness as the core of their devotion.
